Travel just the way it suits you

Travel just the way it suits you

Every journey is unique – just like your wishes. In Lufthansa Business Class, you decide how you want to travel. Enjoy exclusive lounge access as well as priority boarding. On board you can enjoy lots of comfort and space for new ideas, for relaxing and for some productive time above the clouds—exactly as you please. On long-haul flights in Business Class you can look forward to even more thoughtful details and services. More individual options on board ensure that your flight follows your own pace, from the first service to the little extras at your seat, creating a travel experience that feels much more personal.

Arrive refreshed on short-haul routes

On short- and medium-haul flights, the middle seat in Lufthansa Business Class always remains empty. Enjoy more privacy and more space on board for working undisturbed.

More Comfort in Business Class on Short- and Medium-Haul Flights

By 2029, the majority of our Airbus A320 fleet will gradually be fitted with a new, modernized cabin featuring ergonomically optimized seats, significantly larger overhead bins, and USB ports at every seat. In Business Class, the headrests are horizontally adjustable, the backrests recline especially far, and the first five rows offer five centimeters more legroom than before the retrofit – for a more comfortable and relaxing journey on board.

Feel comfortable right from the start on long-haul

With Lufthansa Business Class, you’ll arrive at your destination feeling well-rested. The Business Class seat on long-haul routes converts into an almost two-meter-long bed – ideal for relaxing during a long flight. The open layout, the seating arrangement, and the design in subtle and natural colours create a pleasant and spacious feeling. New practical features and even more attentive service take your experience of a long-haul journey to an even higher level of premium.

A380 new Business Class: More space to relax

Look forward to even more comfort on your journey, as the A380 new Business Class now awaits you on selected Airbus A380-800 aircraft. In our modernized cabin, every seat offers all aisle access, giving you more freedom of movement throughout your flight. Alongside our Classic Seat, two new seating options are now available as well. The Privacy Seat offers more calm and personal space, with the best views right by the window, while the Extra Long Bed lets you arrive relaxed and well rested. For a seating experience tailored entirely to your preferences.

More details for your comfort

At your seat, you’ll appreciate many of the new details in enhanced Business Class: A newly curated amenity kit offers selected grooming and wellness products to make relaxing and sleeping on board even easier. At the same time, we are rolling out new equipment—from tableware and glassware to textiles—to create a harmonious overall feel where blankets, pillows and other details work together seamlessly to highlight the premium ambiance.

Entertainment and Internet on board {heading-small}

Cinema above the clouds: whether it's an exciting blockbuster, a gripping TV series, or the perfect music – our in-flight entertainment on long-haul flights in Business Class offers great entertainment. Sit back and enjoy the diverse selection of movies, TV series, music, podcasts and games.

Thanks to FlyNet®, and with your Travel ID or Miles & More membership, you can use free messaging during your flight – so you stay connected at all times while the world passes by below.

Relax in the Business Lounges

Relax in the Business Lounges

Whether you want to write emails, prepare for important meetings, or have a small snack before departure – in the Lufthansa Business Lounges you will find peace and exclusive comfort. We are also constantly improving our lounges to ensure the most comfortable travel experience before departure, one which continues on board.

Unique in Frankfurt: the Lufthansa Welcome Lounge. Here you will find an area with easy chairs for relaxing and a bistro, as well as high-quality shower rooms where you can freshen up after your long-haul flight.
